newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Aged Belgian paedophile gets eight-year sentence.
newsitem.headline: Aged Belgian paedophile gets eight-year sentence.

text.p: A 64-year-old Belgian with a long record of paedophilia was sentenced to eight years in prison on Tuesday for abusing two young girls over a five-year period, Belga news agency reported.
It was the fourth time since 1948 that Leon Triffaux had been in court on charges of sexually abusing youngsters. After each previous imprisonment he had been pronounced cured.
The public prosecutor had asked for a 10-year sentence after experts declared the man a menace to society.
Belga said Triffaux had forced the girls to perform a wide range of sex acts, using threats of violence to obtain their silence.
Belgium has been in the throes of a child abduction, sexual abuse and murder scandal after the bodies of four girls were unearthed in properties linked to chief suspect Marc Dutroux.
There is no link between the Dutroux and the Triffaux cases.

Child welfare specialists have said hundreds of people -- including some adults -- encouraged by the progress in the Dutroux investigations, have been coming forward to tell of the abuse they suffered in the past.
